_comment: Edit this file to change what the dashboard tracks. Tickers must be US-listed SEC filers.

shares_override._comment: Companies that report share counts per share class do not expose a single total through the SEC companyfacts API. Supply the diluted share count here to enable a valuation.

_positions_comment: Intentionally empty and kept that way: this file is committed to a public repository. Put real holdings in positions.local.json, which is git-ignored (copy positions.local.example.json to start). The build reads them from there and writes the valued result to docs/data/positions.local.json, which is also git-ignored, so nothing about your portfolio is ever published.
